## Goal
Swap the issue's `norn:wf:<old>` label for `norn:wf:<new>` when a round starts (B19), and warn without failing on a label error (B20), per D9.

## Progress
- decide: `round_start` carries `label: {number, remove, add} | null` (null when the workflow stays the same); `WF_LABEL` moved to core `policy.ts` (re-exported from decide).
- act (`roundStart`, lifecycle.ts): after state and the commit, `replaceIssueLabel`; a failure (or no remote port) becomes `ActionResult.warnings`, never a failed action.
- `warnings` flow to the trace (`TickUnitRecord.result.warnings`, schema re-emitted), the tick report's decision lines, and `watch --human` (`WARNING: …`).
- Tests in `packages/cli/test/integration/human.test.ts` (the round describe): AC1 label swap recorded once; AC2 a remote-edited label starts no round over synced ticks; AC3 failing label call → round 4 starts, warning in tick output, trace and watch line.
- Bun quirk: `toMatchObject` with `expect.stringContaining` inside an array overwrote the received value; asserted fields directly instead.
- implement#1 done: round.start swaps the issue's norn:wf:<old> label for norn:wf:<new> after state+commit (D9, B19); a failing label call becomes ActionResult.warnings → trace, tick report decision lines and watch --human (B20). Tests AC1–AC3 in human.test.ts; unit tier + typecheck green.
